messages:
maria: Quick sync follow-up: we prefer subqueue fences + opportunistic prefetch but must finalize eviction contract, pacing knobs, and telemetry before landing.
sam: Concern: thousands of tiny fences => metadata fragmentation and GC spikes. Consider pooled metadata or cold/hot maps.
lee: Proposal: two-layer map — hot-map with explicit structs for top-N tenants, cold-map as compact watermarks for the rest. Promote/demote based on inflight token thresholds.
anika: Eviction contract sketch: soft-evict cancels prefetches & deprioritizes; hard-evict cancels inflight only on SLO breach or emergency. Reclaim order: prefetches -> queued -> inflight small -> inflight large. Emit eviction_reason and idempotency token on hard-evict.
maria: Checkpointing for handoff: hot-map needs full KV snapshot, cold-map checkpoint = {tenant, seq_hint, queued_tokens}. Callers must accept warmup.
sam: Telemetry: per-subqueue metrics, promotion/demotion events, eviction_rebuild_cost, post-eviction tail-latency histogram. Retention: traces 7d, promotions 14d, rollups 90d.
lee: Controls: prefetch_quota (soft, per-tenant) + inflight_quota (strict). Add per-tenant pacing token-bucket. Default examples: inflight_quota=16, prefetch_quota=64, promote_threshold=128.
ops-bot: CI: branch continuous-batching/subqueue-fence updated; tests green.
maria: Action items: sam draft eviction+retry semantics; lee prototype pooled hot/cold maps; anika file telemetry tickets; maria update RFC. Reopen thread if RFC changes land.
